_comment: Crab Breeze's people for the vertex animation texture crowd (openspec/changes/people-vat, design sections 1-3), read by tools/blender/build_people.py. Every body is built by MPFB 2 from the pinned packs (tools/deps/character_packs.json) with the game_engine rig; clips are Quaternius' Universal Animation Library retargeted onto that rig by bone map, plus the clips authored in the build (wave). Lengths are metres, angles degrees.
_comment_regions: Every vertex is coloured by region at run time from the person's palette (design section 4): 0 skin, 1 top, 2 bottom, 3 shoes, 4 hair, 5 eyes. A garment's loose parts (a shirt, a pair of trousers) are top or bottom by the bones that move most of their vertices; an asset listed here takes one region whatever its bones. Every hair style in a body's `hairs` is baked with it; a person shows one (or none, for a body that may be `bald`).
_comment_lods: Two levels of detail baked separately: near (within the near distance of the eye) and crowd (everyone else). Each part goes through a Decimate collapse at its kind's ratio, with its open edges held (cuffs, hems, collars) by hold_edges (the Decimate's vertex group factor), and each hair style to about hair_triangles; the build refuses a level whose body and largest hair together are over budget_triangles (owner, 2026-10-26: 'lower poly characters').
_comment_bake: Each clip is sampled at its source's 24 frames a second, evenly over its length; a loop's last sample is not its first again. Positions are quantised to 16 bits a component over the level's bounds, normals octahedral to 8 bits a component (design section 3).
_comment_wave: The wave, authored over the idle and played once, for the greeting's first 2 s (owner, 2026-10-26: 'wave animation is messed up'): eased in and out of the idle over ease_s; the right upper arm raised raise_deg from hanging, out to the side and forward_deg to the front; the elbow bent so the forearm leans forearm_lean_deg in from upright and swings swing_deg either side at hz; the hand open, palm to the front, following wrist_lag_s late by wrist_follow of the swing; the weight shifted weight_shift_m onto the left foot.
_comment_bone_map: MPFB game_engine bone to UAL (Rigify DEF) bone, from Undercity's bone maps to Godot's humanoid profile (fps-game-demo game/animations/bonemaps at 1363650). A bone not listed keeps its rest pose relative to its parent.
